name: DDL ingest unregister must be exactly-once cleanup

payload.p_check: cancel or rollback calls LitBackCtxMgr.Unregister(job.ID) after add-index ingest resources have been opened
payload.q_claim: all engines and writers owned by the job can be closed and cleaned exactly once

boundary.before: engineInfo has openedEngine and possibly live writers
boundary.after: UnregisterEngines completes and backend context is removed

source_anchors: pkg/ddl/ingest/backend_mgr.go:285-310 removes backend context and calls bc.UnregisterEngines
pkg/ddl/ingest/engine_mgr.go:102-108 iterates bc.engines and calls ei.Clean
pkg/ddl/ingest/engine.go:107-130 closes openedEngine, closes writers, and cleans local files
fix 53849 adds unregisterMu and serializes UnregisterEngines
payload.consequence: DDL worker panic or leaked ingest writers after user-visible cancel
payload.experiment_result: vulnerable revision allowed concurrent duplicate CloseEngine; fixed revision kept close_calls=1 cleanup_calls=1 remaining_engines=0
payload.scope_caveat: root-boundary cleanup exactly-once is verified; full SQL/cluster ADD INDEX + ADMIN CANCEL DDL JOBS user flow remains a separate broad-oracle lift

name: Cancel ADD INDEX after ingest engine opens

trigger_condition.phase: after openedEngine is set for an ingest engine and before the first cleanup finishes
trigger_condition.root_boundary_replay: hold the first UnregisterEngines in CloseEngine, then run a second UnregisterEngines against the same backend context

observe: vulnerable close_calls=2 cleanup_calls=1 while first unregister is still in progress
payload.red_signature: second unregister closes the same engine while the first unregister is still in progress
payload.green_signature: unregisterMu serializes cleanup and subsequent unregister sees no live engine to close
payload.cleanup: release hold hook and remove temporary test assets from historical worktrees
